items.stem: A manager focuses on budgets, schedules and keeping processes running smoothly, while leadership is more concerned with:

options.text: Setting direction and motivating people toward change
options.rationale: Correct: leadership emphasises vision, direction and influencing people, complementing management's control functions.
Approving spend is a management control activity, not the essence of leadership.
Attendance recording is an administrative task, not leadership.

options.text: Avoiding any change to keep stability
options.rationale: Leadership typically drives change rather than avoiding it.

items.explanation: Correct: leadership emphasises vision, direction and influencing people, complementing management's control functions.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A clinic sees many patients but still has long waits because they queue at one overloaded step. The manager should first address the:

options.text: Bottleneck step that limits overall flow
options.rationale: Correct: the constraining step governs throughput, so improving flow starts there.

options.text: Steps that already have spare capacity
options.rationale: Improving steps that are not the constraint will not improve overall flow.

options.text: Total number of patients seen per day
options.rationale: High activity is not the same as good flow; the bottleneck is the issue.
Cosmetic changes do not relieve a capacity bottleneck.

items.explanation: Correct: the constraining step governs throughput, so improving flow starts there.

items.stem: Which TWO belong to clinical governance rather than purely corporate governance? (Select TWO)

options.text: Monitoring clinical audit and patient outcomes
options.rationale: Correct: clinical audit and outcomes are core clinical governance activities.

options.text: Acting on patient safety incidents and complaints
options.rationale: Correct: learning from safety incidents and complaints is part of clinical governance.

options.text: Approving the organisation's annual financial statements
options.rationale: Financial statement approval is corporate governance.
The conflict-of-interest register is a corporate governance control.

items.explanation: Correct: clinical audit and outcomes are core clinical governance activities.
